newsitem.title: FINLAND: NEW INFO DUE AT AMER EXTRA GENERAL MEETING.
newsitem.headline: NEW INFO DUE AT AMER EXTRA GENERAL MEETING.

text.p: New information will be unveiled at an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders in Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy on Monday, Amer chairman of the board Antti Lagerroos said as he opened the meeting.
Lagerroos did not elaborate, but said the meeting would deal with the board's proposal to convert the company's vote-heavy unlisted K-shares into listed A-shares.
Earlier, Amer requested a suspension of trade in its shares on the Helsinki bourse, saying its K-shareholders were in talks with a third party about selling their shares.
